summary.en-US: Fill the browser window with the YouTube player, like fullscreen but inside the window, and still scroll down to the comments.

description.en-US:
Click the button in the player controls (or press ` ) to make the video fill the whole browser window without going into real fullscreen. Unlike similar add-ons, you can still scroll down to read comments and related videos; the YouTube header fades back in as you scroll.

Options:
- Change the shortcut key
- Auto-enable on every video
- Turn scrolling on or off
- Hide the scrollbar
- Floating mini player while you read comments

Esc exits. Turning off theater mode also exits.

No data collection, no network requests, no tracking. The only permission is storage, for your settings.
